title: LandlordGuard Pay-Off Amount: Premium Account Statement Rule
content:
**Rule.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy the pay-off amount is the amount past due on the policy plus the unbilled premium of the current term adjusted by the pay-off percentage, plus the pay-off installment fees, rounded half-up to the cent once on the final figure.

The amount past due is every premium installment billed, fee, returned payment, additional premium and refund posted on the policy, less every payment received and return premium posted, never below 0.00. The unbilled premium is the current term premium less the installments billed for the current term, never below 0.00.

The standard pay-off percentage is zero and the standard pay-off installment fees are zero.

The number of installments in a term is 1 on the annual and mortgagee escrow plans, 2 on two-pay and 4 on quarterly. The installments of the current term not yet billed are that number less the installments already billed for the current term, never below zero.

## Statement layout

| Line | Made up of |
|---|---|
| Charges posted | every premium installment billed, fee, returned payment, additional premium and refund on the policy |
| Credits posted | every payment received and return premium on the policy |
| Amount past due | charges less credits, never below 0.00 |
| Unbilled premium | current term premium less installments billed for the current term, never below 0.00 |
| Pay-off amount | amount past due plus the unbilled premium adjusted by the pay-off percentage, plus the pay-off installment fees, rounded once |

A credit balance does not reduce the pay-off amount: the amount past due stops at 0.00.

## Worked figures (hypothetical policies)

1. **Two-pay term, installment 1 paid.** Term premium 1,200.00 USD; installment 1 of 600.00 billed and paid. Amount past due 0.00; unbilled premium 600.00; one installment not yet billed. Pay-off amount 600.00 USD.
2. **Same term, 650.00 paid.** Charges 600.00 less credits 650.00 is negative, so the amount past due is 0.00 and the pay-off amount is still 600.00 USD.
3. **Quarterly term, installment 2 open.** Term premium 2,000.00 USD; installments 1 and 2 billed at 500.00 each, a 5.00 USD fee posted, one payment of 500.00 received. Amount past due: 500.00 plus 500.00 plus 5.00, less 500.00, that is 505.00. Unbilled premium: 2,000.00 less 1,000.00, that is 1,000.00; two installments not yet billed. Pay-off amount 1,505.00 USD.
